scientific_question: Can four full-width complete MLP functions, shared across depth but selected separately for each token by a layer-aware top-1 router, reproduce the dense 124M teacher's MLP value and input-direction fields at 5TPP?

causal_basis.four_trunk_finding: Four hard depth trunks finish at validation CE 3.8252, +0.1508 behind the matched attention-only model. The model is stable but one static function per depth group is insufficient.
causal_basis.seven_trunk_finding: Seven hard trunks improve to CE 3.7442, +0.0698 behind attention-only, but retain only 1.712x MLP compression and miss the strict +0.05 temporal gate.
causal_basis.private_ridge_finding: One shared 3072-wide field plus 256 private atoms per layer is healthy but recovers only 0.5059 mean output energy, -0.1220 mean JVP energy, and leaves +3.4904 fixed CE. A narrow additive correction does not supply the missing moving field.
causal_basis.derivative_weighting_correction: The preceding private-ridge objective evaluated clean and plus/minus 1-percent perturbations in the same raw output loss. Consequently the derivative signal contributes at perturbation-scale squared and can be numerically dominated by endpoint value. This plan gives normalized central-difference direction loss equal weight to normalized clean-value loss.
causal_basis.novel_mechanism: Every active token receives a complete 3072-wide GELU feature/write field. Four learned expert functions are stored globally, while a layer-specific linear router chooses one expert as a function of the current normalized residual state. This relaxes hard depth partitioning without adding a narrow residual branch or a dense temporal error buffer.
causal_basis.nonduplication: Earlier conditional complete-atom and multi-atom oracles used four procedural BlockFHT-scale atoms at roughly 210-220x compression. This family uses four learned full-width dense experts at 2.99x MLP compression to test whether dynamic reuse of an unrestricted complete field can close the function gap.

family.equation: F_l(x) = D_out,l sum_e h_e(r_l(x)) W_proj,e GELU(p_l * W_fc,e x), with r_l(x)=A_l LayerNorm(x)+a_l and hard top-1 h in the deployed forward
family.routing_gradient: The soft acquisition stages use softmax routing. The terminal stage and all measurements use hard top-1 forward routing with a straight-through softmax gradient during fitting.
family.expert_state: Four learned bias-free full-width W_fc,e/W_proj,e pairs initialized exactly from the four unique trunks of the sealed {0-1}/{2-3}/{4-7}/{8-11} checkpoint.
family.layer_state: Every layer owns one signed pre-GELU gain vector, one positive residual-output log-gain vector, and a four-way affine router. Router inputs are layer-normalized over the 768 channels.
family.inference_note: A grouped dispatch evaluates only the selected expert, so deployed expert GEMM work equals one ordinary dense MLP plus the 0.0651-percent router term. Soft acquisition evaluates all four experts only inside this zero-LM-update ceiling experiment.

fit_protocol.optimizer: Adam over the parameters enabled by each frozen stage

stages.name: soft_joint
stages.trainable: experts, routers, layer pre-GELU gains, and layer residual-output gains

stages.name: hard_top1_joint
stages.routing: hard top-1 forward with straight-through softmax gradient
stages.trainable: experts, routers, layer pre-GELU gains, and layer residual-output gains

fit_protocol.initialization: Expert matrices and layer gains come from the sealed four-trunk checkpoint. Router weights start at zero. Each router bias is +8 for its checkpoint-assigned expert and 0 for the other three, making the initial soft function numerically close to the exact hard four-trunk control without looking at teacher targets.
fit_protocol.objective: L = L_value + L_direction. L_value is equal-layer/equal-bank normalized MSE on clean dense-teacher MLP outputs. L_direction is separately normalized MSE between candidate and teacher central differences F(x+delta)-F(x-delta). Equal weighting prevents the one-percent perturbation from suppressing the direction term by approximately 1e-4.
fit_protocol.best_state_rule: Within each stage, preserve the state with the smallest fit objective only. Stages are a single deterministic warm-start path; no state is selected using holdout output, JVP, CE, occupancy, or wall time.
fit_protocol.parameter_clamps: Layer pre-GELU gains are clamped to [-4,4], residual-output log gains to [-4,4], and router logits are not clamped. Expert matrices are unconstrained.

report: fit and holdout value/direction objectives after each stage
heldout output and analytic input-JVP recovery by layer and state bank
hard top-1 expert occupancy by layer and state bank
fixed-checkpoint validation CE after router-only and terminal joint stages
parameter, deployed FLOP, peak-memory, and wall-time accounting

frozen_gates.optimization_healthy: The terminal stage is finite and either ends at total normalized fit objective <=0.5 or reduces its initial total objective by at least 25 percent.

decision_rule.router_only_pass: Dynamic allocation of the four already-trained fields is sufficient. Implement only the routed four-expert family and MFU-gate a 124M 0.5TPP run.
decision_rule.joint_pass: Dynamic allocation plus co-adaptation of four full-width fields is sufficient. Implement only the routed four-expert family and MFU-gate a 124M 0.5TPP run.
decision_rule.healthy_fail: Reject four full-width top-1 shared experts at 2.99x. Do not sweep expert count, router width, temperature, LR, optimizer, or seed. Use the residual decomposition to decide between a finer global atom pool and a locally generated full-width field.
decision_rule.optimization_inconclusive: Permit only an offline optimizer-geometry repair of this exact oracle; do not infer representational failure or launch LM training.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run this exact zero-LM-update oracle after focused tests and a measured runtime/VRAM preflight.
not_allowed: language-model training before a functional gate passes
expert-count, temperature, router, learning-rate, optimizer, seed, activation, or regularizer sweeps
using holdout measurements to alter the staged path
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll if the measured complete protocol is at most five minutes; otherwise launch one verified @Codex watchdog with terminal/failure callbacks and the standard action prompt.
